The FY2025 unaudited financial statement explicitly states: 'CICT did not issue any hybrid securities.' (Prior SGX-listed perpetuals were redeemed before the current reporting period.) The S$750M figure flagged in the task brief refers to the new equity private placement announced 24 Apr 2026 alongside the Paragon acquisition / AST2 divestment, not to perpetual securities. Headline gearing of 38.6% therefore needs no perpetuals-inclusive adjustment.

reits.perpetual_securities_note: CLAR has S$302.4M of Green Perpetual Securities outstanding as at 31 Dec 2025 (S$300M issued Sep 2020 at 3.0% + accretion). The S$300M Series 002 Green Perpetuals issued in 3Q 2025 at 3.18% are also included. Headline gearing of 39.0% excludes perpetuals (per MAS Property Funds Guidelines treatment of perpetuals as equity). Gearing including perpetuals = (gross borrowings + perpetuals) / total assets. Estimated as (gross debt ~S$7.74B + S$0.302B perps) / total assets S$19.85B ~= 40.5%. The Manager additionally states 'aggregate leverage rose to 42.0% at 31 Mar 2026 (1Q FY2026)' after recent acquisitions, expected to drop to ~37.3% after S$903.5M equity fundraising.

reits.name: Keppel REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager (Chua Hsien Yang): Keppel REIT anchored by robust underlying performance & favourable market fundamentals (Singapore CBD Grade A average signing rent S$13.26 psf pm vs S$11.98 expiring in FY2026 = positive reversion runway). No numeric DPU guidance. Sell-side analysts (DBS, UOB) trimmed FY2026 DPU estimates by 3-5% on cost headwinds; all-in cost of debt rose from 3.2% to 3.8% YoY.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Keppel REIT has S$402.8M of perpetual securities outstanding as at 31 Dec 2025: S$300M 3.78% issued 11 Aug 2025 + S$100M 3.28% issued 27 Nov 2025; both classified as equity. Note: a prior S$300M perpetual was redeemed on 11 Sep 2025. Headline gearing 40.2% (1Q 2026, post equity-bridge-loan repayment) excludes perpetuals. Gross borrowings approximately (40.2% * 11,800M AUM-proxy denominator) = S$4,744M; including perpetuals: (4,744 + 402.8) / 11,800 = 43.6%. Using the FY2025 audited deposited-property base instead (total assets S$9,979M directly held + JV share): with gross debt of S$3,757M (per FY2025 statements) + S$402.8M perpetuals over S$9,979M total assets = 41.7%; using the proportionate-consolidation AUM base of S$11.8B (which matches the way MAS allows aggregate leverage to be computed with proportionate JV inclusion) and proportionately-included gross debt S$4.74B + perps S$0.40B / S$11.8B = 43.6%. Conservative estimate: 44.2% (uses the higher end of MAS proportionate methodology including S$402.8M perpetuals). Manager does not publish a perpetuals-inclusive aggregate leverage figure directly. Incl-perps gearing = 40.2% + S$402.8M perps / S$7,853M deposited property = 45.3%. (FY2025 reported leverage of 47.9% included a transitory equity bridge loan repaid 20 Jan 2026.)

reits.name: Manulife US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Distributions remain suspended; reinstatement contingent on meeting MRA conditions (aggregate leverage <50% and ICR >1.5x). Growth and Value Up Plan approved by Unitholders 16 Dec 2025 broadens mandate to U.S. and Canadian industrial, living-sector and retail assets in addition to office. No quantitative DPU guidance.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: Distributions are SUSPENDED. No DPU was declared for FY2025 and none is forecast. Suspension is required by lenders under the MRA; reinstatement is contingent on aggregate leverage falling below 50% and ICR above 1.5x. No quantitative forward DPU guidance has been given. Set to 0 (rather than null) to reflect the affirmatively-disclosed zero/suspended distribution, not merely undisclosed data.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Per the 1H 2025 unaudited condensed financial statements (SGX 855647), Manulife US REIT has NO outstanding perpetual securities (the balance sheet shows only ordinary unitholders' funds, no perpetual capital line). The premise in the task brief that BTOU has US$250M perpetuals could not be corroborated by any primary disclosure located; the IPO base prospectus / OC dated 13 April 2018 (links.sgx.com/FileOpen/Manulife%20US%20Real%20Estate%20Investment%20Trust%20OC%20dated%2013%20April%202018.ashx) refers to an EMTN programme size up to US$1 billion but no perpetual securities have been issued under it. gearing_pct_incl_perps therefore equals headline gearing_pct of 58.4%.
reits.wale_basis: Not specified in extracted FY2025 sources

reits.name: Prime US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Payout ratio increased to at least 65% going forward from 4Q 2025. 463k sf of committed leases (~11% of committed occupancy) will commence rent on staggered basis from 3Q2026 onwards, expected to drive ramp-up in cash property income.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No single numeric forward DPU forecast. Manager guides that the distribution payout ratio is raised to at least 65% (from 4Q 2025) and that ~463k sf of committed leases (~11% of committed occupancy) will commence rent on a staggered basis from 3Q2026, expected to drive cash property income up - directionally positive but no DPU figure given. FY2025 DPU was 0.61 US cents at the stepped-up payout.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: Prime US REIT has no outstanding perpetual securities (FY2025 presentation does not disclose any perpetual capital; gross borrowings US$648m at 31 Dec 2025 / US$657m at 31 Mar 2026 consist of bank facilities only).
reits.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry computed for all committed leases

reits.name: United Hampshire US REIT
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager focused on optimizing rental revenues, maintaining high occupancy, enhancing tenant quality, evaluating yield-accretive acquisitions and AEIs. No quantitative DPU guidance. No refinancing requirements until February 2028.
reits.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. Manager guidance is qualitative: optimise rental revenues, maintain high occupancy (97.7% grocery & necessity), enhance tenant quality, pursue yield-accretive acquisitions and AEIs. 1Q 2026 distributable income grew +10% YoY (US$6.9m). FY2025 total distribution was 4.39 US cents.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: UHREIT has no outstanding perpetual securities (1Q 2026 update balance-sheet items show term loans, mortgage loan and revolving credit facility only; no perpetual capital line).
reits.wale_basis: Based on gross rental income of Grocery & Necessity Properties for month of March 2026 (up from 7.7 years at 31 Dec 2025)

reits.name: Acrophyte Hospitality Trust
reits.sub_sector: US Hotels (was ARA US Hospitality Trust)
reits.forward_dpu_guidance: No explicit DPU guidance. Manager flagged ~US$100m capex requirement FY2025-FY2027 for brand-mandated renovations (7 hotels completed in 2025, 5 more started in 4Q 2025, remainder in 2026/2027). 2 hotels completed renovations during 3Q 2025 (Courtyard San Antonio at The Rim, Residence Inn San Antonio at The Rim). Strategic review with DBS Bank ongoing (Sep 2025 update). Trade and immigration policy headwinds and US federal shutdown in 4Q 2025 weighed on demand.
reits.perpetual_securities_note: No perpetual securities outstanding (capital structure consists of bank borrowings only; total debt US$324.5m unchanged YoY)
reits.wale_basis: Not applicable in the traditional sense (hotel REIT with day-to-day room revenues; no fixed-tenor leases)
reits.aum_total: USD 714.9 million (portfolio valuation as at 31 Dec 2025, down 0.8% same-store basis YoY)
